purpose: Gate definitions for the ATELIER design-system studio. Every frontier must pass its declared gates before ACCEPT. Mirrors Brand Forge gates, adapted to a design system.

SCI.name: Scientific Quality
SCI.asks: Is the design decision evidence-based and falsifiable? WCAG ratios computed (not guessed), render proven, demo vs real data disclosed.

HER.name: Hermes (it works)
HER.asks: Does it actually render? python runs without error, HTML opens, tokens resolve, no stray template braces, interactions fire.

COD.name: Codex (canon law)
COD.asks: Conforms to canon? Right renderer per surface (SOCC_SURFACE_LAW), naming, file structure, truth_boundary present, reuses existing renderer instead of duplicating.
fail_if: duplicate of socc_canon_html / Brand Forge / INTERFACE

GRD.name: Guardian (adversarial)
GRD.asks: Do N skeptics (a11y + coherence) fail to refute it? Focus-visible on every interactive, keyboard reachable, hit-targets >=24px, one coherent system across both canons, 'a top studio would ship this'.

truth_boundary: Gate definitions only. Declares what each gate checks and the fail conditions. Running gates produces no pixels and makes no external claim.
